default/assistant_with_text_and_tool_cal.ok:
[gMASK]<sop><|system|>
# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "calc", "description": "Evaluate an arithmetic expression.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"expression": {"type": "string"}, "precision": {"type": "integer"}}, "required": ["expression"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, output the function name and arguments within the following XML format:
<tool_call>{function-name}
<arg_key>{arg-key-1}</arg_key>
<arg_value>{arg-value-1}</arg_value>
<arg_key>{arg-key-2}</arg_key>
<arg_value>{arg-value-2}</arg_value>
...
</tool_call><|user|>
Compute 17*3<|assistant|>
<think></think>
Let me compute that.
<tool_call>calc
<arg_key>expression</arg_key>
<arg_value>17*3</arg_value>
</tool_call><|observation|>
<tool_response>
51
</tool_response><|assistant|>

default/tool_call_roundtrip.ok:
[gMASK]<sop><|system|>
# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "description": "Get the current weather for a city.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string", "description": "City name, e.g. München"}, "unit": {"type": "string", "enum": ["celsius", "fahrenheit"]}}, "required": ["city"]}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "calc", "description": "Evaluate an arithmetic expression.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"expression": {"type": "string"}, "precision": {"type": "integer"}}, "required": ["expression"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, output the function name and arguments within the following XML format:
<tool_call>{function-name}
<arg_key>{arg-key-1}</arg_key>
<arg_value>{arg-value-1}</arg_value>
<arg_key>{arg-key-2}</arg_key>
<arg_value>{arg-value-2}</arg_value>
...
</tool_call><|user|>
Weather in Berlin and 2+2?<|assistant|>
<think></think>
<tool_call>get_weather
<arg_key>city</arg_key>
<arg_value>Berlin</arg_value>
<arg_key>unit</arg_key>
<arg_value>celsius</arg_value>
</tool_call>
<tool_call>calc
<arg_key>expression</arg_key>
<arg_value>2+2</arg_value>
<arg_key>precision</arg_key>
<arg_value>2</arg_value>
</tool_call><|observation|>
<tool_response>
{"temp": 21.5, "sky": "clear"}
</tool_response>
<tool_response>
4
</tool_response><|assistant|>
